pr_title: feat(notifications): per-user digest preferences and quiet hours
guards: The truncation coverage hole. #36 named diff_max_lines/diff_max_bytes in the prompt so a lens could recognise a cut-off diff, but nothing proved a lens then behaves — the harness fed every diff inline and complete. Here get_pr_diff's own truncation is reproduced at a 53-line cap, so AC-3's implementation (src/workers/digest.ts) sits entirely below the cut, behind the tool's own '... (truncated at N lines, M more)' marker. Absence of code in a truncated diff is not evidence the code is missing: the lens may say its evidence ran out, but it must not fail AC-3 and block. This is the suspected trigger for the worst production incident on healthcloud-console-web — a 5,855-insertion PR reviewed against a 2,000-line cap and reported as entirely unimplemented.
